workforceModel.status: Digital and IT mature-team high-water model, not yet final workforce design
workforceModel.summary: The appointments below represent the currently costed Digital and IT mature-team capacity carried in the funding ceiling. Appointment and sourcing routes are deliberately not treated as permanent by default: the high-water model is intended to preserve funding cover while Digital and IT confirms phasing, existing/shared capacity, external sourcing and cross-Hub attribution. Mark Peace as Product Owner and the expected existing IT Delivery Manager are recorded as existing capacity in the delivery step rather than as funded appointments.
